reviews.title: Great keyboard just not really much to say otherwise
reviews.comment: So to explain i got mainly the used but looks brand new and in my opinion ive been using it i do like how its has the full size key caps. Also its a great product if you can get it i would recommend it you can also get the full size versoin if you want the tenkeyless version but its a great value for the money. With the feel its very good quality but still have a bit of sharp corner but its great otherwise i have not much complaints.
reviews.author: Trappie

reviews.title: Great keyboard and easy to get used to it.
reviews.comment: keyboard feels heavy and well built, it is sensitive in every keystroke, but it is also responsive, I have programmed the RGB lights to highlight when a key is pressed, so I know for sure if the key was pressed, this way I get feedback of the keys I might misspress and fix it, so, you need to get used to the keyboard, but it will grow on you, trust me.
reviews.author: Andres Fang

reviews.title: Nice keyboard but not good for heavy typists.
reviews.comment: This is a nice keyboard, I like the small size but it is not good for heavy typists like me. I make way too many typos because the keys are too sensitive. I will be getting a keyboard with brown or blue switches with heavier keypresses needed to type instead.
reviews.author: Jesse D.

reviews.title: Dont buy the model with opx switches
reviews.comment: Nice design, horrible switches, dont buy the version with white switches from corsair(opx switches) they are very sensitive so prepare to have a lot of miss inputs, get the cherry mx version
